text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Allllright, today's a celebration! Dance, 
dance, dance--!!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Tap! And also...

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Good work, Trainer!

I merely lent a helping hand. Tap Dance 
City has achieved more than respectable 
results up to this point on her own.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer. Guess it's about time to 
head out.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A base, I say, a base! Isn't it about time 
we called dibs on a nice spot or room?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's go scout it out. Our candidate for 
the Dream Island!

And so, they headed to the shopping 
district's real estate agency to consult 
with them, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What?! You've gotta be kidding. It's not 
nearly enough!?

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I understand your situation, but not 
for that price.

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if you were to borrow it for them 
instead...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Wait!!

Tap Dance City immediately cuts in to stop 
the real estate agent's suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Give me a break with that. You expect 
*me* to live on a ship borrowed by someone 
else?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well then, it won't become a symbol of 
anything. You can't even plant a flag on 
it, can you?

Tap Dance City has her pride too. Unless 
she becomes the master of her own domain, 
it seems meaningless to her.

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text: Then will you pay for it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text: Even if it costs triple the budget?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Are you nuts?! No way, that's absurd.

The wall of reality stood in the way. It 
seemed as though negotiations had hit a 
dead end, but...

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Well, but I understand your dream now. "I 
want a place where I can live with my 
friends forever."

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
I want to support that dream. I watch 
races a lot myself, and I love Umamusume! 
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Here's what we'll do. When you can prove 
that you truly have the strength to 
protect that to the very end—

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
How about I rent you the venue at a 
bargain price? Consider it a form of 
sponsorship from me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A bargain price?! Hahaha! Well look at 
that, you're surprisingly reasonable after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I feel like planting a kiss right on your 
forehead!

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
P-Please stop. I'll get scolded when I get 
home...

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, it's not unconditional. Only 
once you've proven your strength."

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
"You two have only just begun racing, 
haven't you? In that case..."

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
I want her to at least be able to win 
graded races against Senior-class 
Umamusume!

A graded race against Senior Class 
rivals... Faced with this condition, I 
frantically search the race schedule.

Tap Dance City is currently in the Classic 
Class, so she won't be able to face Senior 
Class Umamusume until June of this year...

“If we're aiming for a ‘guaranteed 
victory,’ it's better to wait until the 
end of the year once she's built up enough 
strength.”
In that case—
choice_data_list: Tap, if you win the year-end graded race—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Year's end, huh? Bring it on. In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Listen up! I will win, I'll show you!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Right, the Arima—!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Huh? "Challenge C"?"

As Tap Dance City talks big, I hastily cut 
in with the name of a different race.

"The Challenge Cup. A 2,000m GIII held in 
December. These conditions are likely our 
best bet."

It seemed like the baseline that gave her 
a high chance to win, while also 
satisfying the landlord.

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Oho, the "Challenge Cup," is it? 
Understood. It's still a ways off, but...

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text: Be sure to win our promised race!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I never go back on my word!

And so, after securing an important 
promise, I returned to where everyone was.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And so, our goal is officially set on the 
Challenge Cup!!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Oooh.

The crowd erupted in excitement all at 
once, and then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: By the way, Trainer. —Is that really all?
choice_data_list: What do you mean by just that part?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't play dumb. There's other 
ginormous treasure in the Classic Class, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"What about that? Are we just gonna let it 
slip by?"

Indeed, other races besides the Challenge 
Cup were also in our sights. That is why 
we didn't push her too hard last year.

Perhaps it is time to open up. About the 
route I have secretly been envisioning.
choice_data_list: I think it'd be good... to run in it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: To what?

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Oooh.

—The Classic Triple Crown. This refers to 
the three most prestigious GⅠ races that 
countless Classic-tier Umamusume aim for.

The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, the 
Kikuka Sho. I had considered two of those 
as options.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whew... You're coming out after all? 
Because it's a festival?
choice_data_list: No, to build up your track record.

No, just to build up more of a track 
record.

text_block_list.text:
Just participating in the Classic Triple 
Crown raises your profile. And that 
translates into proving your strength.

Even if not all of them, entering a few, 
and winning the year-end GIII on top of 
that, would be perfect.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Hahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-hah-ha! Isn't this magnificent! To 
think you would prepare such a thoughtful 
detour for us!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. If the wind's good, let's go pay 
a visit to the Triple Crown Island.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course, with the cannon loaded with as 
much ammo as it can hold!
The same day, night—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho and the Kikuka Sho are my 
victories. This simulation—is absolute.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It was unwavering. So why now, at this 
critical moment, is it falling apart? What 
is this abnormal value...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The web-crawler bots are gathering all the 
latest data. There's no intel anywhere 
about an unscheduled Umamusume debuting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why...? Parcae, where—and 
what—did you eat?

Intertwining motives and paths forward. In 
any case, over this past year—

Acquiring a much-needed stronghold above 
all else. To achieve that, winning the 
Challenge Cup was an absolute requirement.
